posts.pt: Dinari: NVDA como dShare 24/7, 'nights and weekends included', 90+ paises, direitos iguais inclusive dividendos e resgate no NBBO. E o UNICO dado real de fim de semana da janela: acao tokenizada rodando com a NYSE fechada. Concorrente do escopo do Mathias — nao nomeado em nenhuma das letras.
posts.a: wall street had the weekend off. the ticker didn't get the memo
posts.b: 24/7 with the same rights, dividends included — that's the part people skip. @Fluxion_network keeps the xstocks book open on @Mantle_Official saturday 3am, and atomic rfq when there's actually size on the other side
posts.c: a stock that stops trading at 4pm friday isn't a market, it's opening hours. liquidity is the product

posts.pt: Superstate: '24/7 transfers, instant settlement... Today it's T-Bills. Next it's everything else.' O par de 10/11 traz o numero deles: fundos tokenizados em US$ 37,8 bi, +940,9% desde o fim de 2023, T-bills liderando com US$ 13,5 bi. Atribuido a Superstate. Angulo: 'everything else' e exatamente equities — o proximo degrau ja existe.
posts.a: t-bills were the warmup lap. nobody runs the warmup lap for the trophy
posts.b: 'next it's everything else' — everything else already trades. tokenized equities with a 24/7 book and atomic rfq, on @Mantle_Official, via @Fluxion_network. t-bills proved the rail, the tickers are the point
posts.c: every rwa cycle opens with treasuries because they're the easiest yes. equities are the harder yes and the bigger one. the 10x already happened at the easy end

posts.pt: Securitize: 'Tokenization is happening right now.' 989 likes — maior engajamento de toda a janela. Quinta de sexta, FORA da linha do fim de semana (declarado pelo Mathias). Vale como QT na segunda, nao como base de thread: o texto e curto e a conversa esta nos replies.
posts.a: 'right now' is doing a lot of work for a market that clocks out at 4
posts.b: happening right now, on a saturday, with the nyse shut — that's the version that proves something. tokenized equities trading 24/7 on @Mantle_Official through @Fluxion_network
posts.c: the argument is settled. the only open question left is who holds the liquidity when it matters, and that's an infrastructure answer, not an announcement

light_hooks.pt: Follow-up de sabado da propria conta: '90+ countries but 24/7 trading of NVDA is the line that gets me. Post so com link (t.co), sem texto, 41/3/4. Mathias nao abriu o card. Segue sem uso ate alguem abrir o destino.

items.text:
the tokenization supercycle is real, but tickers aren't the hard part.

liquidity is. execution is. who fills you at 3am on a sunday is.

that's the part nobody posts about.

an ipo everyone is waiting for, and the version of it that trades at 3am already exists.

the wait was never about the company. it was about the hours.

a leaked api key moved $15.5M this morning.

no exploit, no governance vote, no drama. just a key.

execution isn't a feature. it's the whole product.
